def wrap_text(text, width):
    return text.split()

def row_height(cells, size):
    lines = 1
    for cell in cells:
        lines = max(lines, len(wrap_text(cell, 80)))
    return lines * size

def draw_row(cells, size):
    height = row_height(cells, size)
    for cell in cells:
        lines = wrap_text(cell, 80)
        paint(lines, height)

def emit(rows, size):
    for row in rows:
        h = row_height(row, size)
        ensure_space(h)
        draw_row(row, size)
